objective: Distinguish directly responsible source from noisy historical co-change leads; retain the reachable pool without retuning association scores.
population: All12 exposed cases and every one of the20 frozen co-change proposals. Eight nonempty cases get one GLM verification request each; four empty cases explicitly abstain. No case or candidate replacement.
source_views: SHA-bound canonical base code; first16 lines plus up to3 public-issue lexical-overlap49-line windows, merged without altering source lines. Per candidate at most160 lines/24000 bytes; up to3 witnessed seed files at most120 lines/16000 bytes. Omitted lines and incomplete views explicit. Newly constructed source-only views are not claimed to be historical or native tool delivery.
output: Closed file_ids/proofs JSON. At most3 listed files; every chosen file cites2–4 exact presented candidate line IDs and1–4 presented seed line IDs. Whole enclosing json fence allowed prospectively; no prose, unknown IDs, extra fields, duplicate files, unselected proofs or source-text repair. Citations certify source identity, not semantic responsibility.
label_boundary: All12 outcomes and request/source identities sealed before exposed evaluator access. Keep malformed outputs as invalid, never repaired or dropped. Prior exposed counts select this research question but no labels enter source views, requests or parser.
native_boundary: A source-proxy pass is not native admission by itself: a future live adapter must generate its own source/seed ledger, include verifier cost in the same native budget, and pass actual full-cohort Span/File-F1 gates. No direct frozen native-source edits or unopened confirmation.

construction_boundary.authority: Standing private ARE benchmark and all GLM authorization; D65 candidate
construction_boundary.product_frontier: Exact source-view construction, bounded source-ID verification and sealed whole-cohort analysis
construction_boundary.runnable_product_work: Eight fixed-VPS requests plus four explicit abstentions

claim_ceiling: Exposed source-discrimination development only, not semantic certification, native ContextBench quality or superiority.
open_questions: Can one bounded verifier retain all four newly reachable reference files without selecting noisy peers?
Do the partial source views expose sufficient responsibility evidence?
Would any source-proxy gain improve live native quality after full all-in cost and ledger binding?
